authors: D. Chicherin, R. Doobary, B. Eden, P. Heslop, G.P. Korchemsky, L. Mason, E. Sokatchev
title: Correlation functions of the chiral stress-tensor multiplet in N=4 SYM
claim: Born-level correlators of the chiral part of the stress-tensor multiplet (which, through Lagrangian insertions, generate loop integrands of lower-point correlators) are computed from the twistor-space formulation of N=4 SYM in an axial gauge set by a reference supertwistor Z_*, as sums of propagator-only twistor diagrams, organized by new off-shell superconformal invariants. Results are matched to conventional coordinate-space Feynman graphs for low components (G_{5;1}).
loop_order: Born level for n-point chiral correlators (each extra point = one loop of a lower-point function via insertion); explicit Feynman-graph match at O(g^2) for the five-point component
theory: N=4 SYM, SU(N), chiral sector of the stress-tensor multiplet
scheme: No regularization: Born-level rational functions in 4d (complexified) coordinates; twistor action in axial gauge (cubic Chern-Simons term vanishes, propagator eq. 3.13 with projective delta eq. 3.14). Loop integrands then follow from the 4d Lagrangian-insertion relation (eq. 2.4) using the chiral on-shell Lagrangian as the top component of the chiral stress-tensor superfield (eq. 2.5).
symmetry_argument: The hidden S_{4+l} permutation symmetry is not proved here: it is taken from 1108.3557/1201.5329 and attributed to Bose symmetry of the Born-level G_{4+l} with chiral Lagrangian insertions (Intro, after eq. 1.1). Superconformal covariance and Z_*-independence are argued via absence of spurious poles (Sec. 4.2).

proved: Explicit cancellation of spurious-pole residues for G_{n;1} diagrams (Sec. 4.2, eqs. 4.31-4.43), giving Z_*-independence for that component (extension to higher components called straightforward, not written out).
assumed: Hidden permutation symmetry of the loop integrand (imported from refs. [1,2]).
Twistor-space insertion operator T_A defined by requiring the Lagrangian-insertion relation (eq. 3.21 justified by eq. 3.19): consistency requirement, not first-principles derivation.
Footnote 7: the fermionic integration in (3.17) is claimed to annihilate the anomalous gauge variation of ln det(dbar - A); detailed check deferred.
Chiral on-shell Lagrangian equals the insertion operator up to normalization (footnote 14); total-derivative / equation-of-motion differences and contact terms not discussed.
checked_partially: G_{5;1} at O(g^2) matched with coordinate-space Feynman graphs (Sec. 5, eqs. 5.6-5.24; App. C); G_{4;1}=0 used from superconformal symmetry (Sec. 5.2).
Sec. 6: component (rho_1^2)(rho_3^2) checked at four points (vanishes, eq. 6.7) and five points (eq. 6.12).

evidence: Eq. (2.4)-(2.5): Lagrangian insertion with d^4x and the chiral superspace form of the action.
Sec. 3.2, eqs. (3.13)-(3.21): axial-gauge twistor propagator and insertion operator.
Footnote 7: anomaly of ln det claimed cancelled by fermionic integration.
Sec. 4.2, eqs. (4.25)-(4.43): spurious-pole cancellation for G_{n;1}.
Sec. 5.2, footnote 15: some coordinate-space graphs potentially UV divergent; their sum rational; reproducing eq. (5.15) without G_{4;1}=0 would need a regularization.
red_flags: Lead partly wrong: this is not a twistor proof of the hidden S_{4+l} symmetry; the symmetry is assumed and only Born-level objects are constructed.

The step from Born-level G_{n+l} with integrated chiral insertions to l-loop G_n is never regularized; UV-divergent individual coordinate-space graphs are handled by using a superconformal Ward identity (G_{4;1}=0) rather than a regulator (footnote 15).
Twistor-action chiral anomaly cancellation only claimed (footnote 7).
cross_checks: Consistent with S1c.01_EHKS2011 nilpotent invariants; O(g^2) components match ordinary Feynman graphs (App. C).
notes: Lead 'twistor proof of the permutation symmetry' was inaccurate (see red flags). Journal from search result snippet, consistent with memory. Follow-up 1506.04983 (bootstrapping chiral correlators) not covered.
